name: movie-ticket-booking-system
description: 电影票预订系统 - Node.js Express + Vue3 + Bootstrap + MongoDB

scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:db" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.start:frontend: cd frontend && npm run build && npm run preview
scripts.start: npm run dev:db && concurrently "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
